==Biography==
Started playing video games when he was 4 years old on the old Gameboy. In season 2 he got introduced to League of Legends, but almost only played normal games. In season 6 he began try harding and got to Challenger by the end of the season. His professional career started on the russian [[Team Empire]] in March 2017. 

== Trivia ==
* Admires [[Shemek]] and [[sOAZ]].
* Originally a {{ci|Kled}} one-trick, and has an excellent winrate on the pick as a pro.
